mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, NVL(EMAIL, 'no-email@example.com') AS EMAIL, NVL(POINT, 0) AS POINT, SYSDATE AS REG_DATE FROM TB_USER WHERE STATUS = #{status} AND ROWNUM <= 10 ORDER BY USER_ID DESC
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, NVL(PHONE, '010-0000-0000') AS PHONE, SYSDATE AS NOW_TIME FROM TB_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER ( USER_SEQ, USER_ID, USER_NAME, EMAIL, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_USER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{email}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_USER
USER_NAME = #{userName},
EMAIL = #{email},
POINT = NVL(#{point}, 0), MOD_DATE = SYSDATE
WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
